correctness.rationale: Independent generator equations recover w_1=D/kappa, w_0=D/kappa+D/nu; forward 2x2 covariance propagator has characteristic z²+(kappa+2nu)z+kappa nu, giving the two-exponential covariance and exact recovery of D, sum and product from derivatives. Quadratic inverse roots give only rates (kappa,nu) and (2nu,kappa/2). Fourth-order generator equations yield m4=3D²[(sum)^2+3(sum)kappa-4(product)]/(product)^2, strictly distinct for non-self-dual aliases. Independent rational generator/moment identities and twins checked across 40 positive triples. Correctness of the theorem is established, not originality.
